title: Boxed Lava
body:
"Oh my goodness! For how did they do it? Put such a firey substance into a box? We may never know..."

Description

Boxed Lava is a structure available for purchase at the Magma Cave Shop for a price of $5,280. Once placed on your property, it transforms into an orange cube that can be resized to dimensions of up to 15x15 studs.

Functionally, it behaves like regular Lava found throughout the game. Boxed Lava differs from Boxed water as it possesses the capability to inflict harm upon the player.

Trivia

When it was first added, the placed lava acted like water, But with an update, lava is no longer swim-able.
